title: audit detail wrap.put
description: detail of audit rows with action wrap.put: key wraps were submitted (POST /v1/wraps by a user, POST /v1/device/wraps by a device): the number stored and the number ignored as already present. Metadata only (02-data-model.md section 2.9); every value is flat (string of printable ASCII up to 256 characters, integer, boolean or null) like the generic detail of api/org-audit.response.json.
